name: trie-ide
description: Coding agent: local GGUF via embedded trie-daemon, or any OpenAI-compatible LLM API (Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI, Kimi, and other cloud endpoints). Hybrid mode adds sparing frontier-model guidance — local model runs the loop, cloud only when it matters.

Trie Coding Agent: Connect & Load Local Model
Trie Coding Agent: Configure Hybrid Mode
Trie Coding Agent: Configure Web Search
Trie Coding Agent: Install Local Inference Runtime
Trie Coding Agent: Stop Embedded Daemon
Trie Coding Agent: New Agent Session

enumDescriptions: Trie IDE daemon (embedded or external) serving local GGUF models over localhost.
Any OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions API — local (Ollama, LM Studio, llama-server) or cloud (OpenAI, Kimi, etc.).
trie-ide.backend.description: Which inference backend drives the agent loop.

trie-ide.daemon.url.description: Base URL of the Trie IDE daemon (trie-daemon).

trie-ide.daemon.autoStart.description: When backend is daemon, start the embedded trie-daemon if none is reachable at trie-ide.daemon.url.

trie-ide.daemon.keepRunning.description: Leave the embedded trie-daemon running after VS Code closes (server mode for other clients).

trie-ide.daemon.command.description: Advanced: shell command to start an external trie-daemon (empty = use embedded daemon bundled in this extension).

trie-ide.daemon.storePath.description: Model store volume path on the daemon host (empty = daemon's home directory).

trie-ide.daemon.contextLength.description: Context length to load local models with.

trie-ide.api.baseUrl.description: Base URL of any OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` API — local (Ollama, LM Studio, llama-server) or cloud (OpenAI, Kimi, etc.).

trie-ide.api.modelName.description: Model id on that API (e.g. qwen2.5-coder:7b, gpt-4o-mini).

trie-ide.api.apiKey.description: Bearer token for cloud APIs; optional for local servers.

trie-ide.agent.maxToolCalls.description: Maximum tool calls per agent turn before the loop stops.

trie-ide.agent.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for the agent model.

trie-ide.frontierAssist.enabled.markdownDescription: **Hybrid mode** — consult a frontier (cloud) model for advisory guide notes when the local model is stuck or finishes a turn. The frontier model never drives the tool loop and never edits files. Use the **Settings** button in the sidebar or **Trie Coding Agent: Configure Hybrid Mode**.

trie-ide.frontierAssist.provider.description: Hybrid mode: frontier provider (OpenAI or Anthropic).

trie-ide.frontierAssist.model.description: Hybrid mode: frontier model name (empty = provider default, e.g. gpt-4o or claude-sonnet).

trie-ide.frontierAssist.apiKey.markdownDescription: Hybrid mode: API key for the frontier provider. Required when hybrid mode is enabled.

enumDescriptions: Web search disabled — the web_search tool is not offered to the agent.
Tavily (tavily.com) — search API built for AI agents.
Ceramic (ceramic.ai) — low-cost web search API for LLMs.
trie-ide.webSearch.provider.markdownDescription: **Web search** — give the agent a `web_search` tool. Requests go directly from your machine to the provider using your API key; nothing is proxied through Trie.

trie-ide.webSearch.apiKey.markdownDescription: Web search: API key for the selected provider. Required for the `web_search` tool to appear.

trie-ide.webSearch.maxResults.description: Web search: maximum results per query (1–10).
